description: Get the cheapest ticket price for each day of a month for a route (a price calendar). Uses IATA city/airport codes. Example: travelpayouts_price_calendar({ origin: "MOW", destination: "BCN", depart_date: "2026-08", currency: "usd", _apiKey: "token:marker" })

calendar_type.description: Which date to key the calendar by: "departure_date" (default) or "return_date"

depart_date.description: Month to build the calendar for, format YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

return_date.description: Return month/date, format YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

name: travelpayouts_price_calendar
title: Travelpayouts Price Calendar
